name: scrapeeverything-apify-actors
description: Apify actor sources powered by the Scrape Everything API (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix actors/instagram-profile-scraper && npm install --prefix actors/tiktok-profile-videos-scraper && npm install --prefix actors/youtube-transcript-scraper
scripts.test: npm run sync:check && node --test test/client.test.mjs test/actors.test.mjs && npm test --prefix actors/instagram-profile-scraper && npm test --prefix actors/tiktok-profile-videos-scraper && npm test --prefix actors/youtube-transcript-scraper
